title.narrative: Procurement of Goods and Services for the PDCVEP Project in Cameroon

description.narrative:
The Livestock and Fish Farming Value Chains Development Project (PDCVEP) stems from the Cameroon Government’s desire to make the livestock and fisheries sub-sector participate actively in the quest for economic growth capable of generating jobs and significant incomes in rural communities. This vision is operationalized through three pillars: infrastructure development; capacity building of sector actors; and project coordination and management.

UNOPS procures and supplies vehicles and agricultural equipment to strengthen the project activities.
